name: Death & Co
address: 433 E 6th St (between 1st Ave & Ave A), New York, NY 10009
status_note: Official NY location page live with current hours and menu (checked 2026-10-18); no closure or renovation notice. Brand added a Seattle outpost (Sept 2026), unrelated to the NY bar.

dress.detail: Neither the official location page nor NYC Tourism lists a dress code; NYC Tourism describes a dark, somber, classy-hotel-bar atmosphere.

sources.name: Death & Co New York (official) - no cover mentioned; seated-only, first come first served

getting_in.value: Walk-ins always welcome and mostly first come, first served; limited reservations on SevenRooms; parties up to 8, no standing room, 2-hour limit. Door takes your number and texts when a seat opens.

subway.value: F at 2 Av (Lower East Side–Second Ave) or 6 at Astor Pl; roughly 7–12 min walk

skip_if: You hate waiting: seating is mostly first come, first served and peak-hour waits can run long (reviewers describe leaving a number and being called back).
You want to stand and mingle or stay all night: no standing room and a 2-hour cap per visit.
